description:
Smart temperature display bottle 500ml is a vacuum insulated stainless steel flask that tells you the real drink temperature before you sip. Tap the LED touch cap and instantly check if your coffee is still scalding hot or if your baby’s water is safe to drink. Built with food‑grade 304 stainless steel and double‑wall vacuum insulation, it helps keep beverages hot or cold for hours—ideal for office desks, school bags, gym sessions, and travel.

The leak‑proof lid makes it bag-friendly, so you can carry it without worrying about spills on laptops or notebooks. With a sleek, premium feel and BPA‑free contact parts, it’s a smart choice for daily hydration—tea, coffee, soup, or chilled water—without guessing the temperature.
